title: Our Apartment
subtitle: Three rooms, an old green sofa, and a window the sun comes through.
description: An A1 reading and listening text describing a small apartment, teaching furniture words and the prepositions that put things in a place.
source: authored for this site; no source document
lexicalSet: an A1 naming text: the short passage is a frame for the everyday words the glossary teaches
passage: Our apartment is small, but we like it. There are three rooms: a bedroom, a living room, and a kitchen. The bathroom is next to the bedroom.
I like the living room best. There is a big window, and the afternoon sun comes in. Under it is an old green sofa from my grandmother.
Next to the sofa there is a small table with books. On the wall there is a picture of Ohio. The floor is wood and cold in the morning.
The kitchen is small — two people cannot cook in it together. There is a stove, a refrigerator, and a shelf for the plates.
In the bedroom we have a bed, a desk, and a chair. Jack works there every day. The window is on the street, so we hear the buses.
It is not big. But it is warm, it is near the park, and it is ours.

exercises.title: Understanding the Text
exercises.instructions: Read again and choose the best answer.

items.prompt: How many rooms does the apartment have?
items.explanation: A bedroom, a living room and a kitchen — and the bathroom next to the bedroom.
“Under the window there is an old green sofa.”

items.prompt: Where does the sofa come from?
Why can only one person cook?
options: Because the kitchen is very small
items.explanation: “Two people cannot cook in it together.”

items.prompt: What does Jack use the desk for?
items.explanation: “Jack works at the desk every day.” He works from home.

items.prompt: Why do they hear buses in the morning?
options: Because the bedroom window is on the street
Because they live near a bus station
items.explanation: “From the window we see the street, so in the morning we hear the buses.”

exercises.title: Where Is It?
exercises.instructions: Complete each sentence with the right word.

items.explanation: Next to means at the side of.

items.prompt: There is a picture ___ the wall.
The plates are on a ___ in the kitchen.
items.explanation: A shelf is a flat board for putting things on.
A desk is a table for working or writing.

items.prompt: The apartment is small, but it is ___ in the winter.
items.explanation: Warm is a little hot, in a good way.

items.statement: The living room has a big window.
items.explanation: True, and the sun comes in through it in the afternoon.

items.statement: The floor is cold in the morning.
items.explanation: True. “The floor is wood, and in the morning it is cold.”

items.statement: Emma does not like the apartment.
items.explanation: False. “we like it” — it is warm, near the park, and theirs.

discussion: Is your home big or small?
What is next to your bed?
What do you hear from your window?
